connector.name: Oura Ring by AntVsl
connector.registryDescription: Sleep, readiness, HRV, resting heart rate, activity and stress from your Oura Ring
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package my-oura-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the antvsl account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: OURA_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Client ID of your Oura application from developer.ouraring.com

env.name: OURA_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Client secret of your Oura application

env.name: OURA_REDIRECT_URI
env.description: OAuth redirect URI; must match the Oura application byte for byte

env.name: OURA_API_MODE
env.description: sandbox for Oura's synthetic data (no auth needed), production for your own

env.name: OURA_TZ
env.description: IANA timezone deciding what counts as today. Set it explicitly on servers, whose clocks run in UTC

env.name: OURA_TOKEN_STORE
env.description: Where the OAuth flow stores tokens. Written by the server, not set by hand

env.name: OURA_PUBLIC_URL
env.description: Public https address of this server, without a trailing slash. When set, the server runs its own OAuth 2.1 authorization server so claude.ai and the mobile apps can connect; leave empty for Claude Code, which authenticates with OURA_MCP_TOKEN

env.name: OURA_MCP_TOKEN
env.description: Shared secret guarding the HTTP endpoint. Required whenever the server binds to anything other than loopback; without it the server refuses to start
